tei:div.tei:p: byedh+ri rto ba ༷ hūṃ byeX pyi hūṃdī ༷ bye/dī ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃX ṭ+wāṃ sbyi / ༷pyo/ ṭ+wāṃ/ sdu dī rdoX mkho
4 /7snyeyetram̐ snye ṭ+wāṃ shā ju ༷ngu 7 rtso kāṭ+wāṃtsā— sbyi dziphro

sto rtesnyeno snye tho ྅ dhene+epyo hūṃrte+o3snrer+sha’ nyiriskonyi/rmogerked+ku 9 stacho skred+mā ljosnyi sgrojarna/sbur+ha /daji je d+ngharna lophaḍaḍagle rjomolke bye snyernoXbye spre ༷ 3tsha trī ṭaṃ54 sne/snyo(phro—preloji1 rga dz+wakoṭābye rdzo wā spe khu zhuci—rdebyetre ༷'itshwakai hūṃk+ṣiṃshordospro ḍā/ nyi4 ༷ snasho —rirtewa 4 —༷༷pyomāṃ ༷ (k+ṣede〉—ngaj-i //༷rnge stu je)〉ngh+ru nepo /( —rdod+ngha9snyerdo+okyi geri —chodidīshāsdetrī dzo ༵rmepre shā byu pho ri bhe —du byā
ji dzi rta1 bhe4 / sprorme / phurisnesmo4riri1 trekro5 7 dz+wa 7tre snyehūṃze spre ༵ spya
ro༅/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis sam srog bdag rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal gyi byung ba brjod pa'i sa bon nyer mkho bzhugs so/ /(rkyang tsha )bsodanams grags pas brtsams/

rgyal chen karma badz+ra de nyid gnas gzhan du sprul ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs kyis bstan 'gro'i don mdzad pa/ (1)sangs rgyas bkra shis khong nyid yul gang du sku 'khrungs shing chos sgor zhugs tshul dang sgrib sbyong byas tshul sogs bshad pa/ (2)sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi sku'i bkod pa sdud tshul sogs bshad pa/ (12)7rje kirti blo bzang 'phrin las mchog gis bka' bsgos dam la bzhag nas chos srung du bkod tshul/(16)rkyang tsha'i rgyal dge dgon pa'i dpa' rtsal btsan khang nang khong nyid las byung ba'i rten gtso rnams dang sku rten gyi byung rim sogs bshad pa/ (24)

༄༅/ /sangs rgyas bkra shis sam srog bdag rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal gyi byung ba brjod pa'i sa bon nyer mkho bzhugs so/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs/ /dbyer med sgo gsum dang bas 'dud gyur nas/ /rong chen bstan pa'i sgron me'i bka' srung zhes/ /karma badz+ra'i byung ba mdo tsam bri/ /rgyal chen katā bar+sha de nyid gānas guzhan du spruswā t+tawa ṭārtehā bhā / ༵dzosna kyā/sa de yang ji skad du/ rgyud ni yongs su smin gyur nas/ /gang dang gang la gang dang ni/ /gang tshe bya ba phan gyur ba/ /de dang de la der snang ngo / /zhes gsungs pa dang / rnga yul kirti'i dgon chen dge ldan legs bshad gling gi a lags gnyan rtse sprul 1ba'i

sku blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma'i zhal snga nas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du rgyal bo dad pa'i dbang bo/dpal ldan sham bha la na rgyal bu dge ba'i 'od zer dang / lha gnas sum bcu rtsa gsum du 'od ldan dkar por sprul nas lha min gdug pa'i dpung tshogs 'joms pa/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas par sdong grogs mdzad pa/ 'og phyogs klu yi sde dpon klu rgyal gtsug na rin chen der sprul nas gsang chen chos kyi gter mdzod 'dzin pa/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon rig 'dzin 'jam dpal grags par sprul nas rig 'dzin 'dus ba'i tshok+tas gral 'grimasasna/sbo'i gangs can bod snro ljonga~X lja rter/ 'ar+sha~X r+sha~Xkā ༵/ — 'a rnam 'phrul mthu —na rwa — sangs rgyas bkra shis khong nyid yul gang du sku 'khrungs ging chos sgor zhugs tshul dang sgrib myung byas tshul sogs bshad pa/2 de yang mdo smad gdul dka'i ljongs 'dir

'jam dpal 'i khro mi yi gar du rnam par rol ba'i yul ni/ spyir bod chen po la chol kha gsum du phyes pa'i mdo smad rta'i chol khar rma klung dal gyis 'bab pa'i dbang gis byang rgyud dang lho rgyud gnyis las lho rgyud the bo'i char gtogs/ de'i rus rgyud ni yul dbus nas chad pa yin te sngon rgya'i rgyal bo thang gis sa 'di bzung yod pa chos rgyal srong btsan gyis blangs nas sa bsrungs pa dang / phyis su yang chos rgyal khri srong gis sa mtshams bsrung bar bka' ma log pa'i dmag dpon mi dgu dang yang chos rgyal khri ral ba can gyis dmag rtsed 'gran skabs/ dar ba zer bas g.yag chen po gnyis mchan khung g.yas g.yon du bcug ste sa la ma reg par khyer bas dar ba g.yag khur zer ba de dmag sde thams cad las bud pas na ming la de bud zer ba the bo'i sar so mtshams bsrung bar mngags pa'i mi rgyud la phyis su de bud zer ba sgra 'gyur nas the bo zhes 'bod pa 'di nyid la stod smad gnyis su phyes pa'i stod pa'i char gtogs/ rkyang tsha'i chab tshan gyi nye 'dabs a nyan phan chu bya 3ba'i

gnas der/ rab byung bcu gnyis par yab rta mgrin dbang rgyal dang yum phag mo gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs shing mtshan la sangs rgyas rdo rje zhes gsol/der ma zad phan chu'i mkha' 'gro ma dang phan chu'i rten rgan bya ba'i lha chen tshangs pa'i sku rten rgyal dge sprul sku 7rje 'jigs med seng ge tshang dang 'jigs med blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma tshang / da lta zhal 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa'i 7rje blo bzang dkon mchog rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo tshang dang bcas sku phreng gsum gnas 'dir bar ma chad pa rim par 'khrungs pa sogs dam pa du mas bstan 'gro'i don rgya chen po bsgrubs pa'i gnas lags so/ / 'on kyang phyis su phan chu'i tsho ba de mdzod dge bzhag ldom gyi sa ru spos ba yin/ deng sang phan chu'i gtsug tor hreng zhes ba de sangs rgyas rdo rje khong nyid 'khrungs sa'i sgom brgyud yin par grags/de nas sangs rgyas rdo rje khong sku na me tog gi lang tsho phra ba'i dus su rgyal dge dgon du chos sgor zhugs shing dran pa bkra shis kyi mdun nas rab tu byung ba sdin snyam/ de las bka' chos yang du ma gsan

par grags gang ltar rab tu byung nas mtshan la sangs rgyas bkra shis zhes gsol/ kha cig gis sangs rgyas rdo rje zhes pa de rab tu ma byung ba'i gong gi mtshan yin par nges/ sangs rgyas bkra shis zhes pa yongs grags yin la khyad par khong gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen lung bzang nang ba sku phreng dang bo blo bzang bsam gtan gyi rang rnam las/ thogs med blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi/ / thugs sras bdag gi mkhan bu rnam dpyod can/ / dad dang blo gros cher ldan mkhas dbang mchog / dge slong blo bzang sangs rgyas bkra shis kyis/ / lo rgyus yi ger 'khod ces yang yang du/ / bskul ba phyi ru zlog pa ma nus ngor/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyis yi ge 'bri klog dang rgyud sde gong 'og kun la gsan bsam gnang zhing tshegs med du mkhyen/ smon lam 'cham chen gyi skabs su khong chos rgyal gyi 'cham gar la rol mkhan zhig yin pa dang / khyad par bzo rig par sbyangs shing mkhas par gyur nas lha'i bzo bo bī sho karma'i 'gran zlar 'os pa lta bu zhig byung / khong gi rdo

mtshar 'phrul gyi pur rtse las byung ba'i phyag bzo'i skor/sman lha bde gshegs brgyad dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi thang kha sogs gser dngul las bris pa'i gsung rab pod du ma yod kyang bcos bsgyur skabs 'ga' re 'jig song / da skabs dgon pa'i nang bdag tu zin yod pa ni/ seng gdong sngags 'khor/ma ṇi mthong ba kun grol gnyis kyi par shing / lag rnga 'brug sgra rang grags bzo dbyibs blta na sdug pa gcig 'cham dpon gyi phyag phur bzo dbyibs rta glang sgrul gsum gyi mgo can gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phur bu sogs yod/ brag shug mgo'i khong nyid kyi sgrubs gnas su khong gi zhal 'don gyi thar mdo dang phyag bzos las grub pa'i rten sgam bshags lha so lnga'i sku thang bcas yod/ de nas smon lam spyi chen sogs dgon pa'i las khur mi nyung ba zhig mthar phyin rjes/dgon pa'i las sna yongs la da ni khos mi tshe don ldan du bya bar sgrib sbyong byed 'dod che bas gnang ba zhig ces zhus pa dang mnyam du stsal/ de nas stag tshang lha mor6 phebs te rong chen bstan pa'i sgron me sku phreng lnga

ba kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi mdun nas 'jigs byed bsnyen khrid sogs gsan rjes phyir phebs te rgyal dge dgon pa'i g.yas logs su brag shug ri khrod bde chen byang chub gling du shing pho byi ba'i spyi lo (1744)lo zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la lung bzang nang ba sku phreng dang po blo bzang bsam gtan mchog gdan drangs nas lam rim dmar khrid dang bde mchog lu i ba'i dbang sogs zab chos du ma gsan te bsam sbyor gnyis kyi sgo nas bla ma'i gtso bor bstan pa yin pa ni 'di ltar/ mchog de nyid kyi rang rnam las/ lo mig dmar shing pho byi ba'i lo'i/ /zla gnyis pa'i mar ngo'i tshes gsum nyin/ / bdag lo lon ban rgan stobs chung rung / /sems bzang bos bskul nas rkyang tsha'i stod/ / gnas bde chen byang chub gling du phyin/ / dad blo gros thos rtsal dang ldan pa'i/ / bu sangs rgyas bkra shis dpon slob la/ /bka' dgongs 'grel gzhung lugs ma lus pa'i/ /don kun 'dus gdams pa'i rgyal bo mchog / chos byang chub lam rim dmar khrid kyi/ /'khrid mdesngi rtse

rang la bstan nas bshad/ / dpal lu i'i lugs bzang bde mchog gi / dbang rnam pa bzhi yis smin par byas/ /lam cha kun ma lus legs tshang ba'i/ /chos mdo sngags gzhung la skal ldan byas/ / zhes gsungs/ de nas sgrib sbyong gi lta goms mdzad pas maṇ+ḍal gyi sa gzhi lan gsum brtor ba sogs sngon 'gro'i rim pa yang dag mdzad nas/ bde mchog sogs khyad par 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs shing ya ma rā dzā dung phyur gsum bgrang bas bsnyen pa'i phreng ba rdog rer g.yag rgan zhig gi mig rdo 'dra ba yod zer srol yod kyang de zad pa sogs kyi tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong bla na med pa mdzad mthar/ yang lung bzang nang ba blo bzang bsam gtan mchog gi zhal gdams mgur tshogs las/oṃ bde legs su gyur cig sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam mgon blo bzang grags/ / brtse chen rang gzugs blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyan/ / grub pa'i dbang phyug blo bzang smon lam zhabs/ / gsol ba 'de~Xs so rgyun 'dzin bu slob tshogs/ / 'bral med

byung chub bar du brtse bas skyongs/ / byin rlabs mchog mthun dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /rnam dag blo ldan dad gus rab brtan pa'i/ /dge slong blo bzang sangs rgyas bkra shis khyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba mtha' dag ring dor nas/ /dal 'byor rten la snying bo len pa'i phyir/ / dus gsum rgyal bas mgrin gcig legs bsngags pa'i/ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ / rab brtan yid 'ong mdzes pa'i dga' tshal du/ / thub bstan bsgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin la bzhugs/ / mtshams kyi bcad rgya mdzad nas rnam dkar la/ / brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bskyangs pa'i glus/ / bdag yid mdzes ma sim nas dga' gar 'khrab/ / rnam dkar las la gzhol ba'i bu khyod kyis/ / sngon tshe khrims sogs dge ba mang bsgrubs mthus/ / lam mchog sgrub snod 'dzam gling mi lus thob/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i dge ba'i bshes dang mjal/ / gzhung lugs blta byed blo gros mig dang ldan/ / rnam dkar mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i dus 'di ru/ / ma zhim snying stobs cher bskyed 9thub

dbang gi / gzhung lugs spyi dang khyad par gdams pa'i gnad/ / skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa dang / /zab lam rim pa gnyis la rim bzhin du/ /shin du brtson pas sku tshe don ldan mdzod/ / dad pa rab tu brtan pa'i bu khyod la/ / rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ / byin rlabs thugs rje'i chu 'dzin cher dkrigs nas/ / dngos grub bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bebs par shog / mi lhod dam sdom brtan pa'i bu khyod la/ / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mi'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen kun gyis mi g.yo bar/ /rdo rje ltar brtan mthun rkyen grogs byed shog / tshul 'di sprang btsun 'jam dpal rdo rje yis/ /dad gus blo gros ldan pa'i lha bzo la/ / srung mdud dang bcas dben gnas lung bzang zhes/ /dga' ldan byang chub chos 'phel gling nas phul/ /dge bas bdag cag dpog slob rnam gnyis sogs/ /chos mthun spyod pas rtag tu 'tsho bzhin du/ / tshe mthar phyi nas don gnyis lhun 'grub pa'i/ / zung 'jusdu dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di ni

dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan gyis/ /rang gi slob bu phan chu ri khrod pa dge slong sangs rgyas bkra shis la gdams pa'o/ / zhes sogs gsungs pa la brten nas/ mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal 'bos sbo tshang gi sar lha mo gser khri'i dgon lag dkar mo klad kyi dgon pa'i grwa sar zhugs shing slob gnyer mdzad/chibs drel rkang dkar yang de'i skabs sbo tshang nas khyim tshang zhig la gnyen dmag skya brgya'i thang ka zhig bzhengs par yon du phul ba yin zer srol yod/ de nas phyir brag shug ri khrod du phebs/ brag shug ri khrod bde chen byang chub gling de la lha mo gser khri nas khri ba zhig mngags srol yod zer yang / sangs rgyas ṭ+wākrashilhaṭāngagisku'ibaṭ+wāṃd d+nghabasdukārjernyibragashug r+sha sdot+na rno hūṃ byenā ṭ+wādri hāṅgi sdodū bye /rang sa — sa rgyal da—

sangs rgyas bkra this kyi sku'i bkod pa bsdu tshul sogs bshad pa/sangs rgyas bkra shis khong spyi lo ( 174kha —1771)bar zhig la sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa yin snyam/ ci'i phyir na/ lung bzang nang ba sku phreng dang bo blo bzang bsam gtan sang spyi lo (1749)la 'das pa'i skabs sangs rgyas bkra shis zhal bzhugs par grags pa dang / kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog spyi lo (1771)la sku 'das pa'i sngon la sangs rgyas bkra shis 'das par grags pa'i phyir/ gang ltar gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu skabs mtshams g.yog grwa ba zhig yod pa de la/ khyod de ring lha mor song ste kirti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog gdan drongs dang / ngas sngar zhus zin nga 'chi khar khong phebs rgyur zhal bzhes yod ces mngags par/ grwa ba lam nas rtsed mor g.yengs te ma song bar phyir logakhong gis ci gsung dris par/ grwa bas nga de ring lha mor /ṭāng ste kiti tshang la yar de ltar zhus par khong

gis khyed kyi a khu 'chi rgyu mi 'dug khong phebs khom med gsungs 'dug ces dang / nyid kyis da 'chi rgyur skrag nas mi 'dug gzhan gyis nga la ci zer gyin 'dug ces dris par/ gzhan gyis khyod sgrib sbyong ba yin pas lhar skye ba'am yang na khong khro che bas 'dre ru skye rgyu red zer gin yod/ ces rdzun smras par/de nyid khong khro lhag par shin tu langs te/ gzhan gyis nga lha ru 'dod par lha dang / 'dre ru 'dod par 'dre yin da lta chibs drel la sga cha gyis zhes par chibs drel rkang dkar yang dus der lto sbos nas shide nas bzung mtshams g.yog grwa ba de la rkyang tshas 'dre kha mang ma zhes 'bod/ dus der kirti sku phreng lnga ba bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog la mkhyen nas mar drel thang bya bar byon dus/ khong gi spyan gyis nam mkha' la gzigs bzhin phyag dbyug lan gsum mdzad nas da ngas phan ma thog tha kho nam mkha'i dbyings sprin gyi dkar nag mtshams su khong khro rab tu 'bar bzhin phyag dbyug tha ma'i tshe phyir bltas 'ig byas pa la dpyad na sku phreng rjes ma zhig gis phan thog rgyu red snyardo 3zhes

gsungs shing yar lha mor phebs/ de nas bzung shi gshed kyi lab gleng 'bar zhing mngon sum mig gis mthong rgyu byung ba sogs/ snang ba ma dag pa 'dre ru 'dod pa rnams la gdug tsub shin tu che bas bdud kyi rnam par bstan/ 'on kyang sngar khong gi sgrub gnas kyi lung bar dwangs mo ru ba gong 'gab gnyis kyis zhabs tog phul ba la brten nas/ ma bskul dang blangs kyis sdong grogs mdzad par grags pa sogs lo ngo rgya phrag gcig dang bcu phrag gnyis gsum tsam la dus kyi snyigs ma'i dbang gi snang ba ma dag pa rnams la thag pa sgrul du 'khrul na lha bdud du babs pa'i tshul bstan pa sogs cung zad spro na 'di ltar/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyi mthong tshod la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs stas 'dre gdon sdig pa can dang rkun jag chom gsum byed pa sogs mi dge ba'i las stobs che ba rnams bsgral ba yin te/ nyin zhig rkun ma jag par grags che ba'i mi zhig nad gzhi chen pos mnar ba la bla ma zhig gdan drangs te bla mas 1kasungs pa ltar na/ nad bdag ni dge slong gi

cha byad can dang rdzu 'phrul dang mthu stobs mnga' bas rkyang tsha'i drel nag can yin snyam/ nad pa'i srung bar sman lha yi dam du sgom tshe nad bdag dge slong gi cha byad can de sman lha'i ngo bor gyur ba dang yang 'jigs byed yi dam du sgom tshe nad bdag de nyid 'jigs byed kyi zhal phyag yo ngas su rdzogs pa'i ngo bor gyur song / da nga yang ci bya brtol med du gyur bas sbyin bdag gi re ba bsgrub pa'i bya thabs dang bral zhes gsungs/ yang rkyang tsha'i rgyal dge dgon pa'i g.yas logs su ri rked kyi lam phran 'du khang gi glo sgor zug yod pa de sngon sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi tshogs lam yin pa mngon/ deng sang lam phran de'i g.yas g.yon nas sa brkos tshe sa dmar mang bo mthong rgyu yod/phran gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rgyal dge dgon gyi bla ma gzhung gnas pa a khu dpal ldan mchog la/ deng sang lam phran de'i g.yas g.yon nas sa dmar mang bo 'byung de'i rgyu mtshan ci yin zhes zhus par/ mchog nyid kyis sngon sangs rgyas bkra shis kyi tshogs lam yin phyis su de nyid sku gshegs nas ༵zung

snang ba ma dag pa'i mi rnams la bdud kyi rnam pa'i cho 'phrul mang bo bstan/ dus der rgyal dge dgon pa'i nang du yang sngar gyi kho bo'i tshogs lam brgyud de chibs drel gyi rmig sgra dang dril gdangs khrol ba bcas phebs bzhud mang ba grwa ba res gnyis kyi mthong thos su gyur/ grwa ba de skrag nas lam phran der sku 'bum dang bka' 'gyur sogs bzhugs su gsol nas ngo 'gog byas par sngar las lhag pa'i mthong thos dang 'jigs bskul 'dra min byung ba la brten nas bka' 'gyur sogs blangs ste lam phye bar zhi 'jam du song bar grags gsungs/7rje kirti blo bzang 'azin las mchog gis bka' bsgos dam la bzhag nas chos srung du bkod tshul/de nas/ de'i rjes su kirti sku phreng brgyad pa 7rje blo bzang 'phrin las dkon mchog bstan pa rgya mtsho1 ༵chog gis rkyang tsha'i drel nag can 'di nyid

gdul ba'i dus la babs pa mkhyen nas/ a lags rmog ru tshang la rkyang tsha'i drel nag can 'di nyid lha sar 'god pa'i dus la bab pa lta bu'i ltas 'ga' zhig byung bas de ltar bgyis na 'grig gam mi 'grig de 'grig na khyod kyis kyang nga la de thabs su 'gug pa'i grogs byed dgos gsungs par/ a lags rmog ru nas de bka' drin shin tu che bas cis kyang da lam de ltar gnang dgos zhes lha rdzas dkar pos sne drangs te mthun 'gyur byas/ de nas a lags rmog ru tshang gis rkyang tsha'i drel nag can de nyid thabs su 'gug par grogs sgrig ste nyin zhig rgyal dge dgon pa'i mdun ri'i nags 'dabs su khong gnyis khams bsang du bzhugs skabs a lags rmog ru'i zhal nas/da ni dus mi 'gyangs par 7kirti ‘blo bzang 'phrin las kyis khyod dam la btags nas lha sar 'god pa'i dus la bab yod khong gis bka' bsgos pa bzhin de ltar byas na legs snyam zhes zhal gdams mdzad/ de'i rjes su 7rje kirti blo bzang 'phrin las dkon mchog bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog nyid 'khor dang bcas rdi sti lo

(1ṭ+wāṃr2)lo'i zla 2tshes 11nyin rkyang tsha'i chab tshan du phebs te tshes 15 bar sku mtshams dam por bzhugs/ rkyang tsha tsho gsum las khyim tshang gcig kyang ma lus par bsang rdzas bsdu ru bcug ste/bsang yig ( ngasacan bsagacigam)gsar rtsom byas te tshes bco lnga'i nyin bsang dang gtor ma btang tshe nub phyogs kyi mkha' dbyings su sprin nag po spra gur lta bu zhig byung ba thag nye ru phyin pa na je chung je chung du song ste bar rer lho phyogs dang bar rer byang phyogs kyi ri rtse nas rgyang blta byed bzhin 'dug de'i tshe rje nyid nas dmigs pas dmigs bya bkug ste hriḥyig la bstems shing bka' bsgos dam la bzhag de nas phyir chibs kha bsgyur lam dang bo rgyal dge dgon du phebs khong gi phyag gis bris pa'i bsang yig gangs can skyabs gcig ma de gnang ste da nas bzung tshogs 'don gyis gsungs/ bsang yig de ni/ 18

rgyal bo rdo rje dpa' rtsal gyi bsang mchod rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs/hrīḥgangs can skyabs gcig pad dkar 'chang ba'i lha/ / snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /dbyer med khyab bdag rdo rje drag rtsal gyis/ /thugs rje'i byin gyis dregs pa dbang du bsdus/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs dang / / chos dbyings rten 'brel bslu med bden pa'i mthus/ /mchod tshogs nam mkha' mdzod du yongs spel zhing / /mchod 'os mgron kun thog med spyan drangs gyur/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /snying la chags kyang las smon nus pa yis/ / stobs ldan mi min dregs pa'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ / gsang mtshan rgyal chen rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal/ / rgyal btsan dmu bdud the'u rang 'khor tshogs bcas/ / dus gsum g.yar dam ji bzhin skad cig la/ /dbyar gyi char rlung 'tshub bzhin da tshur spyon/ / dga' mgur rangs pa'i sems kyis brtan par bzhugs/ /19bde

stong ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i sgyu 'phrul las/ / 'dzad med 'dod dgu'i dngos por byin rlabs pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i gtor ma sman phud rak+ta'i skyems/ / spyan gzigs tshogs 'khor go mtshon srog chags dang / /dar zab 'bru sna lha bsang dud par bcas/ /gtsang zhing ma tshang med pa'i mchod tshogs kyis / /gsol lo mchod do brngan no dgyes par rol/ /dbang drug zag med bde bas tshim gyur cig /dkar dmar mdzes brjid 'dzum zhing sma ra 'khyug/dbang rtags rdo rje bdud rtsi'i thod pa 'dzin/ /dar ber chos gos sag theb 'gul phreng brgyan/ /gru mor spa 'khar me long dar snas mdzes/ / rdzu 'phrul drel nag rkang dkar steng na 'gying / / res 'ga' rab dmar mdung dar mda' gzhu 'dzin/ / btsan rmog rgod ldem dar dmar cod paṇa can/ /'ja' sprin me rlung dbus na glog ltar 'gyu/ / blon 'khor mi srin dregs pa'i dmag dpung bcas/ / mchod cing bstod kyis bka' dang dam la 'dus/ /hūṃ hrīḥrdo rje 'cha~X dbang pad+ma sam+bha wa/ / khyab bdag bud+dha badz+ra

brgyud par bcas/ / rigs gsum mgon po khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal/ / rdo rje srin po ma hā kā lar bcas/ /dbyer med dgongs pa gcig pa'i bka' yi lung / / dus gsum rdo rje'i tha tshig gnyan po yis/ /bla ma'i bka' srung chos 'khor srung ma ru/ / mnga' gsol gzengs bstod dam bsgrags gnyer gtad na/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i rgya las ma 'da' bar/ / ko long gdug tsub phrag dog nyer bar spongs/ / snang srid chos kun sems kyi rol gar las/ / sna tshogs rten 'brel cir yang 'char ba la/ / don dam gshigs su dmigs med ro gcig pa'i/ / spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang nyid nas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag cho 'phrul 'phrin las kyis/ / bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde legs tshogs spel/ / mtha' dbus chos byed mtha' dag bu ltar skyongs/ / rnal 'byor bdag cag bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs/ / nad yams mug rmatshon mtha' 'dre'i gnod pa bzlog / chos srid dpal 'byor zas nor longs spyod spel/ / yid mthun 'dod dgu'i dngos po dbang du bsduswā/1 /

rgyal ba'i bstan dgra bla ma'i sku dgra sgrol/ /mdor na bla ma yi dam srung ma yi/ /bka' dam rdo rje'i ri mo ma nyams par/ /zhi dul byams pa'i sems kyis grogs mdzod la/ / dkar phyogs chos kyi dbu 'phang srid rtser bstod/ / rgyal ba'i bstan dang bla ma'i 'phrin las rgyas/ /'jig rten khams su lo legs bde skyid 'phel/ / mi dang mi min sems mthun chos la //'o/95/ /:sgob/sa/ cedzab/thag pa/shādi 21sa/ ṇ+ḍa1 bstunozug khuraphe95 bzan nabyesnartena'abri'i/ṭ+wāṃpy-irngo sdutsho 3zlo /droṭāṭ+wāṃshādītrīshādastodrimagibari trīsakritrīhrotri'adi/ro/nga/chosarje'isgrulamingabasa'acurtsedaklu'irgyalabo'iphobrangadusbyarajid//sasa' la da' skabalda srung ma lha mo gdong dmar ma bar phabs ni sngon mdzod dge shog bcu gnyis kyi nang khul las rkun ma sogs yin min gyi rtsod pa byung tshe rgyal dge dgon pa'i 'du khang sgo lcags la bzung ste man 'a dpang 'jog dgos pa'i srol yod/ mna' zos tshe dgon pa'i lcags ri'i phyi ru thon pa dang mnyam du snying khrag bzhes pas kha nas khrag phyung ste shi 'gro de ltar dus dbang gis je mang du song ba rje nyid nas ma bzo~X par lha mo gdong dmar ma'i sku thang la lha dar

phul nas zhi 'jam btang / phyis su zhi drag gnyis kyi sgrub 'phrin bskang gsol sogs cho ga cha tshang gsar rtsom gnang ba da lta gsung 'bum du bzhugs/ khong nyid la rgyun du bsnyen bkur dang zhabs tog phul ba'i sbyin bdag rkyang tsha'i zhwa chen ru ba'i lha bzo bsam 'phel bya bar thogs dang bo'i srog bdag rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal kyi sku thang bzhings su bcug par/ lha ris pas rje nyid la ji 'dra byas nas bzhengs zhus par rje nyid 'dzum bzhin du gdong kha'i bzod pa rag rwa shes sam phar cher 'al de dang 'dra bar gyis zhes gsungs pa bzhin bzhengs/ de yang / zhi drag gnyis ka drel nag rkang dkar la chibs shing / zhi ba sku mdog dkar la dmar ba phyag g.yas pas dbang rtags gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga ba 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas rin po che'i gter gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/dbu la sag theb dang sku la chos gos gsum sogs gsol ba'o/ /drag po sku mdog dmar bo ru dar dang thod skam gyi dbu rgyan can zhal rab tu khros te ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ phyag g.yas pas mdung da2༵

g.yon pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ sku la gser khrab sogs gsol pa'o/ / gzhan yang rkyang tsha'i drel nag can zhes bya ba 'di nyid the bo'i rkang lor 'khrul ba kha shas yod kyang / tshe tan zhabs drung tshang gis/rkyang tsha'i drel nag can gyi lo rgyus mi shes pa tshos 'di dang the bo'i a myes su grags pa gnyis gcig tu byas pa ni 'khrul ba ste/ the bo'i a myes ni slob dpon pad+ma'i sku ring la bod kyi bsam yas bzhengs dus shāspyod/ pa byed mkhan gyi 'byung bo zhig cesasogs sunga'abumarkyang tsha'i rgyal dge dgon pa'i dpa' rtsal btsan khang nang khong nyid las byung ba'i rten gtso rnams dang sku rten gyi byung rim sogs bshad pa/deng sang yang rgyal dge dgon du srog bdag rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal gyi btsan khang nang rten gyi gtso bo rnams ni/ 7rje kirti blo bzang 'phrin las khong nyid kyi dz+wa~Xs khrag gis bzhengs pa'i srog bdag rdo rje

dpa' bo rtsal zhi drag gi sku thang dang / sangs rgyas bkra shis de nyid kyi sku gdung mchod rten/ gong du bshad pa'i khong gi phyag bzos las grub pa'i seng gdong sngags 'khor dang ma ṇi mthong ba kun grol gnyis kyi par shing / lag rnga 'brug sgra rang grags/'cham dpon gyi phyag phur rta glang sbrul gsum gyi mgo can gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzo dbyibs blta na sdug pa bcas bzhugs/ sku rus cha tshang ba de sngon brag shug ri khrod bde chen byang chub gling nas khri ba zhig gis yar lha mo gser khri dgon du khyer song yang phyis su rgyal dge dgon pa'i grwa rigs a khu re phrug bya ba de nyin zhig gser khri tshang gi mdun du bos te lha mor song bar/ gser khri tshang gis nged kyis kyang dpa' bo rtsal 'di nyid bsten 'dod yod‘ kyang nged kyi shugs ldan dang 'di gnyis cha gi ma red/ des na dpa' bo rtsal gyi sku rus cha tshang ba dang thang ka g.yang mda' bcas khyed rgyal dge dgon du phyir 'bul sprad bya rgyu yin pas khyod kyis khyer gsungs/ de nas a khu re phrug dga' bzhin rgyab la khur du byas nas rang spya5gon

du gdan drangs par grags/ phran gyis kyang sku rus de nyid dngos su mthong myong / mthong rkyen ci zhe na/phran gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo 'dul 'dzin pa a khu dpal ldan mchog khong gis nyin zhig gong tshugs bzhes pa'i skabs shig la phran gyis/ a khu lags nga de ring snga dro lha khang gi yang thog tu song ste shing gi mchod rten ches rnying rul du song ba zhig mthong / de ni ci zhig gi mchod rten red ces zhus par khong gis/o de ni sngon dpa' rtsal gyi sku gdung mchod rten yin kyang da lta rnying rul du song bas slar gso mi rung /da skabs ngas mchod rten gsar bzhengs kyi yon bdag cig btsal yod grub rjes sku rus dang bcas btsan khang du bzhugs rgyu yin zhes gsungs/ phran gyis sku rus de da lta gang na yod ces zhus par/ de da skabs nga'i lag tu yod ces yar bzhengs te blangs 'ongs pas 'di red khyod kyis ltos dang 'di ni dpa' rtsal gyi sku rus yin zhes gsungs/ ras khug khru gang 'dra ba gnyis kyi nang btsub rus sogs rus sna yod pa mtho~X / nyid kyi zhal nas sku rus 'di bcos bsgyur

gyi dus 'khrug skabs rang dgon gyi ban log dga' phyug ru ba'i (rdor mkhar ram )rdo rje mkhar gyis sbas skong byas thub song / phyis su dgon par yar 'bul sprad byas pas da skabs nga'i lag tu yod pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin zhes gsungs 'dug phyis su btsan khang nang du gdan drangs te mchod rten nang bzhugs skabs grwa tshang nas spyan 'dren gsung ba dang mnyam du ngo mtshar gyi ltas mi phal ba rnams kyis kyang ha go rgyu yod pa bzhin/ dgon pa'i g.yas logs su sngar khong gi ya ma rā dzā'i sgrub phug gi thad nas mar rlung 'tshub g.yas skor du 'khyil ba lta bu'i ngang dgon pa'i lcags rir g.yas skor byas te btsan khang du thim song /der 'tshogs pa'i mi rnams ha las te had kyis 'dug pa lta bu byung / da skabs kyang 'dre gdon rnams mi'i khog par zhugs pa'i nad pa rnams dgon pa'i nye 'dab tu bsdad de nad gzhi de las grol ba dang de'i bar chad las bzlog phyir phyag skor byed dus/ de rnams kyis kha lab ste gnas 'dir srog bdag rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal zer ba phyag g.yas pas mdung da~X7 brang

khar me long thog pa khong khro rab tu 'bar bas 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug ngas nad pa 'di nyid la gnod 'tshe spang ba ma zad phyin chad rkyang tsha'i yul 'dir mi 'ongs pa'i dam bca' bzhag pa yin/ de ltar ma byas na bsgral rgyu red zer ba sogs mig mthong lag zin du gyur ba de dang de 'dra yod/ de nas dus kyi mtha' ma 'di lta bu la bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du mi'i khog par zhugs nas bka' lung 'bab pa'i dus su bab/ de yang sku khog dang po rnga yul kirti dgon dge ldan legs bshad gling gi sku rten dar rgyas dang / stag tshang dpal gyi lha mo kirti dgon dge ldan bkra shis 'khyil gyi sku rten (rnga phrug kha lo'am )chos 'phel gnyis la bstan srung karma badz+ra 'di nyid kyi sku phebs shing phyi lo nga dgu'i dus 'khrugs par bstan 'gro'i don rgya che mdzad yod kyang da skabs sku khog gnyis ka 'tsho bzhugs gnang med/ de'i rjes su bstan srung 'di'i sku khog gi dogs gzhi yod pa rnga ba kirti dgon gyi grwa blo bzang bzod pa grwa blo (rajam/ lha mo spuñcā dgon gyi grwa dkon mchog nyi ma sogs la sku

phran bu re phebs rgyu yod kyang lha sgo ma phye bar phyis su dwangs song / de las sku rten dang bo dar rgyas dang chos 'phel gnyis 'khrungs yul ni/ mgo log khul gcig sgril rdzong khang sar mgo log ru bar yab gsang bdag dang yum gyi ming gsal bo ma shes pa de gnyis las gcen po dar rgyus ni spyi lo (191ra)lo sa rta la 'khrungs shing spyi lo (1khar4)lo shing byi la sku gshegs/gcung bo (rnga phrug kha lo'am )chos 'phel ni spyi lo (192 1)lo lcags bya la sku 'khrungs shing 'das lo mi gsal ba de gnyis mgo log nas rnga yul du 'khyams 'ongs nas dar rgyas ni rnga ba kirti dgon gyi 'tshogs gral du zhugs/ de'i gcung bo chos 'phel ni lha mo kirti dgon du phyin te 'tshogs gral la zhugs pa yin/de'i rjes su rnga ba kirti dgon gyi grwa blo bzang byākra shis lags da lta zhal 'tsho zhing bzhugs pa khong nyid rnga ba bkra shis lha sde 'gab ma ru bar spyi lo (1kha70)lo lcags khyi la yab rgyal mtshan dang yum jo mo gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs shing sku na phra ba'i dus su rab tu byung ste rnga ba kirti dgon dge ldan legs bshad ltizlo du

chos sgor zhugs/ spyi lo (19ṭ+wāṃrdo)lo sa 'brug la rgya gar du phebs te rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang du bzhugs nas slob gnyer gnang zhing slad nas kirti byes pa grwa tshang nas dbu mdzad kyi 'gan yang bzhes/ spyi lo (200rkya)lo lcags 'brug la khams cung ma bde ba'i skabs g.yu sgron mar zhus par/ khyed la lha zhig 'bab grabs byed bzhin 'dug na byab khrus byed dgos zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub pa a khu dge 'dun gyis nyin bdun ring byab khrus gnang mthar/ dgong mo mtshan gyi chu tshod gcig gi thog lha dang bo der rang phebs tu byung ba red/ nga rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal yin/ rdo rje dpa' rtsal zhi drag gnyis ka phebs thub rgyu yod pa dang / kho'i sku khog de yag po yin zhes gsungs/ rong chen bstan pa'i sgron me sku phreng bcu gcig pa 7rje blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med ye shes rgya mtsho mchog gi zhal nas gsungs pa bzhin spyi lo (2rkyarkya0)lo'i zla 7tshes 2ṭ+wāṃnyin zhogs pa chu tshod 6 5thog khong gi mdun du rdo dz+wa 0dpa' bo rtsal gyi sku khog la rdo rje drag ldan dang

bse khrab pa rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal dga' gdong sogs phebs te/ de ring 7gong sa lnga ba chen mo'i dus chen khyad par can yin pas rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal gyi rten khog 'di 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen mo'i dngos slob rong chen mkhas pa mi bzhi'i ya gyal shar yon tan mgon po'i rnam sprul yin pas/ 7rgyal ba rin po cher zhus te ngos 'dzin mdzad dgos pa sogs zhus par/ khong nyid kyis 7gong sa mchog la snyan gseng phul/ 7gong sa mchog nas gus pa pho brang du shog ces sogs bka' phebs pa ltar sku mdun du bcar ba dang lam seng rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal phebs nas phyag dang mjal dar phul/ 7gong sa mchog gi sku bang du mgo gtugs te snyan seng zhus skabs 7gong sa mchog nas sku rten gyi mgo bo sku bang du phyag gis dam du bzung nas bzhugs skabs/ chos skyong rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal nas 'di ltar/ nga rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi rnam sprul rgyal chen rdo rje dpa' bo rtsal yin/ rgyal bo chen po sku lnga dang dpa' ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mos bka' bsgos pa ltar 'dir yong ba yin/ bstan pa rdipyo phra

ba'i skabs 'dir gang nus kyis zhabs phyi zhu nges yin/sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra dol rgyal nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen mo'i mdzad 'phrin la bar chad byed bzhin yod pas/ nga dpal rta mchog rol ba'i skur bzhengs nas 'dul ba'i dus la babs yod pas ngas rtags mtshan thon nges zhu gi yin/ nga la sdong grogs dang rgyab rten mdzad rogs/ khyed dpal rta mchog rol ba'i ngo bor bzhengs nas nga la bka' bsgo mdzad dgos/ zhe sogasazhu bananagyisasulasong0ra tregongasaskyabasamagonachenapomachoganasam ladaralhagamadudaganang nas gagayonapasadapa'aza lagyimajingabanasakaudubazung /ri bas lha/sdugol la jil dzadade skung bam gadzol/)srung ma khyed — skor na sa zhus song / khyed rang 'dir yong bar nga zhe drag dga' bo byung / bod bstan srid kyi don du sha tsha dang zhen khog yod pa'i srung ma zhig red 'dug nga ston pa shākya thub pa'i rjes 'jug dge slong zhig yin dus nga'i ngos nas nus pa gang yod bton gyin yod/nga gcig bus nus pa thon thub pa khag po 'dug7gong sa lnga ba chen po'i sku dus nas bzung lha mi zung 'bresdu byas nas bstan pa chab srid bskyangs pa red/

deng sang bod kyi bstan srid ches nyag phra ba'i skabs 'dir lha mi zung 'brel byas nas las don sgrub dgos/phyogs gang sa nas bltas na'ang bod kyi bden mtha' gsal la nye ba'i dus shig tu slebs yod/ lha re zung ma gtogs de min slob dpon rin po ches bka' bsgos dam bzhag gnyer gtad mdzad pa'i srung ma thams cad rdog rtsa gcig tu sgril nas bsdad yod/ngas deng sang rta mgrin dam sri zil gnon gyi bsnyen sgrub byed bzhin pa'i skabs yin/ ngas sngon ma dol rgyal bsten pa red/ de ngas nor ba red/ lo shas sngon rta mgrin khams gsum zil gnon gyi sgo nas dol rgyal la dmigs su bkar nas sgrub pa byas pa'i skabs mtshan ma yag po rgyud / (derngi bas shāgisadapa'atho sdozagari misagamigayangayangaganangabaginadu)dal rgyal byas rkyan pas skyas chan dam pu mang bo zhig gi mdzad 'phrin lam lhong mi yong ba dang chos lugs nang phan tshun dam tshig ma mthun pa yong gi yod dus khyed rang tsho lha srung rnams kyis nus pa ci yod bton pa'i dus la babs yod/ bstan pa nyag phra ba da lta'i dus tshod 'dir nus pa mi bton na ga dus nus pa bton gyi yin nam/ da nus pa ༵ton
